title: SpideyIRL
tagline: A real-life Spidey Sense you wear on your head.
description: Wearable headband that turns nearby obstacles into directional vibrations, with a voice assistant that tells you what the camera sees.
imageAlt: SpideyIRL banner: a real-life Spidey Sense, built at Hack the North 2026
role: My part: speech recognition (Vosk) and text-to-speech (Piper); also worked on the hardware, debugging, the pitch and the Devpost submission

awards.title: 3rd Place
awards.detail: QNX: Create an Embedded System with QNX that Uses AI

highlights: 8 ultrasonic sensors mapped to 8 vibration motors, 45° apart
Reflex path runs fully offline on QNX, independent of the AI
Offline voice interface with Vosk + Piper
224 passing offline tests by the end of the hackathon

story.heading: The idea
story.body: Can we give someone a sense they did not have before? Peter Parker's Spidey Sense tells him where danger is before he sees it. We built a headband that does the same: something on your left, your left temple buzzes. The closer it gets, the faster the pulses.

story.heading: How it works
story.body: Two independent paths, because reflexes should never have to wait for intelligence. A Raspberry Pi running QNX reads eight distance sensors, validates the measurements and drives the vibration motors locally. A second Pi on Linux runs a YOLO object tracker on the camera feed and an offline voice pipeline. Ask "what's in front of me?" and the camera frame, the detected objects and your question go to Qwen 3.5 Omni Flash, and the answer is spoken back to you.

story.heading: What we learned
story.body: Building a new sense is an interaction problem, not an information problem. Touch tells you where something is, voice tells you what it is, and neither should overwhelm the wearer. We also designed for failure from the start: missing sensor readings stay unknown instead of reading as empty space, stale camera frames are rejected, and AI requests have hard deadlines.

gallery.alt: SpideyIRL system architecture: a reflex lane on QNX and an understanding lane with camera, microphone and Qwen 3.5 Omni Flash
gallery.caption: System architecture: the reflex lane never depends on the AI lane.
